title: Blue/green rollback at 3am
situation_md: Our blue/green deploy started routing traffic to the new fleet at 02:45 UTC. Five percent of requests immediately returned 502s; the new fleet had a misconfigured upstream timeout that only manifested under real prod load.
decision_md: I executed the rollback within 12 minutes — flipped the LB back to the old fleet, then rolled the new fleet's deploy. Then I documented every step in a public runbook so the next person can hit the button without an oncall escalation.
outcome_md: Customer-visible impact: 15 minutes of partial 502s. The new runbook has been used three times since with no SEV escalation.
context_md: Cloud: AWS. LB: ALB. Old fleet: m5.xlarge x 12. New fleet: m6i.large x 16.
